versions.changelog: Upgrade to v1.2.0-intl: unified copyright notice, case source annotations, emoji decoration, cross-file link verification
v1.1.0: Full skill package with all supporting files

B2B PM Super Workbench now introduces full-stack capabilities and strict output standards.

- Major upgrade to version 1.1.0-intl with expanded description and output requirements.
- Integrates 50+ product methodology frameworks, 30+ deliverables, 12 chart types, 3 prototype types, and 5 PPT types for B2B product managers.
- Introduces clear output standards requiring detailed disclaimers and author info in every response.
- Includes comprehensive quick navigation and deep dive into B2B vs B2C product management differences.
- Adds concise guides, competency models, and modularized references for easier access to core resources and best practices.
